The '''''Pertorqus candus''''', more commonly known as the '''whiteworms''' or '''crystal worms''' of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], were enormous creatures that inhabited the towering [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Nesting in burrows dug out of the crystalline world's crust, the whiteworms' skin absorbed energy from the planet's core and converted it into food. Equipped with a circular maw of jagged [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] for chewing through the planet's crystalline mountains, whiteworms had been discovered as early as the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and had been noted in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Runforyorlife.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Concept art by Sang Jun Lee]]
The Mygeetan whiteworm was a species originally seen as concept art for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] that went unused as the storyline was mapped out. However, the species was given a name and canonized with its inclusion in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']].
